data.long_meaning: Adelawi is a name of Arabic origin, meaning 'Friendly, Generous'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'Adil', which means 'Just, Fair'. The suffix '-awi' is added to the name, which means 'My People', giving the name a sense of belonging and connection to a community. The name Adelawi carries the meaning “Friendly, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Adelawi usually hope their child will grow to embody friendly, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
